text:
Maria: morning team — need a quick sync on Q3 Hosted API scope. we must finalize tradeoffs: chat latency optimizations, embeddings SLA asks, and a rerank batch API by EOD Friday.
Kevin: constraints from eng — we have one 8-week infra window before Dedicated ramp. realistically we can take on 2 infra-heavy projects max.
Sasha: sales asking for embeddings SLA: 99.9% availability + P95 <= 120ms for small vectors. that’s tight given cold starts.
Olga: research POV — we can use prewarm + prefix-KV caching to hit P95, but it increases memory and warmup ops. also need to test quantized embeddings for quality.
Rana: infra note — prewarming 3 variants across regions ups GPU reservation cost ~25%. need finance signoff or scope cache to top customers only.
Maria: propose three options: A) prioritize chat latency (target P95->200ms) + best-effort embeddings; B) commit to embeddings SLA + build rerank batch API, defer big chat infra; C) minimal ops: rerank beta + batching tweaks only. pick a preference.
Kevin: leaning A or B. A helps product velocity; B secures enterprise deal (ACME) asking explicitly for embeddings SLA and rerank.
Tom: ops: rerank batch will spike disk I/O for metrics/logs. option: route heavy batches to Dedicated initially to isolate impact.
Sasha: we can ship a simple async rerank batch endpoint quickly: max_docs=5, polling, 3-week ETA. meets customer needs without deep infra changes.
Olga: quant eval plan: 2-week run, metric is cosine delta <= 0.01 vs baseline, plus latency and memory profiles. will need 2 GPUs for testing.
Maria: decision leaning list — 1) scope chat infra to the most impactful hot paths rather than full rebuild, 2) commit to embeddings SLA for top-3 customers with staged rollout, 3) ship beta rerank batch API and route heavy jobs to Dedicated fallback. approve?
Kevin: +1 on scoped chat work. we can land kernel tweaks that don't blow the infra window.
Rana: I'll surface exact prewarm numbers and cost delta in SSO by Wed. blocking until finance confirms.
Tom: ops will add routing policy: if batch_size > 10 -> dedicated-pool. otherwise host on shared. add retry path -> hosted.
Maria: action items: @Olga run quant eval (due Tue), @Rana cost calc (due Wed), @Kevin update scoped chat PRD (due Thu). I’ll draft roadmap/OKR updates. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: quarterly roadmap doc updated -> https://drive.redwood/roadmaps/hosted-q3
Sasha: add PRD launch criteria: clear latency SLAs, contract language for customers, rollback policy, and canary gates. keep it concise.
Maria: agree. if no vetoes we’ll lock this slice. meeting Fri 11am if issues. thanks everyone.
